Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce one opaque full-bleed native1254-square game-map detail for r09_c09/r04_c02. Image1 gives exact framing, scale and existing object footprints. The TOP115 rows and RIGHTMOST115 columns are native neighbor references: preserve existing contours, grooves, materials and shadow endpoints at their exact coordinates; north wins the shared top-right corner. Rows115..229 and columns1024..1138 contain guide-only soft transitions into regional context. Rebuild those into continuous painting; never copy guide bounds as walls, steps, dark bars, abrupt texture changes or truncated grooves. Reconstruct the soft interior as crisp native detail. Image2 is the user-approved primary painting/material style: bright, clean, rounded, full-bodied Daoist chibi fantasy with smooth readable bevels and restrained low-contrast surfaces. Copy no UI, text, symbols, floral ornaments, characters, lighting or objects from Image2. Keep ONLY objects and materials already present in Image1; no additions, recropping, repositioning, rotation or enlargement. Quiet ivory stone: no grit, cracks, veins, stains, bright scored scratches, harsh brush patches, blur or sharpening halos. Rounded clean existing leaves. No new buildings, stairs, medallions, frames, labels or watermark. Return only this single native detail image.
Specific inventory: almost empty warm ivory stone pavement with ONE existing broad curved brown stone groove close to the upper edge, exactly at its current coordinates; at far right, a small cropped red curled lantern arm with gold bead and a vertical cropped red edge continues out of frame. The existing soft lavender-grey shadow of the lantern runs across the lower half. Keep its silhouette and soft edge. Keep the single curved groove continuous across the top, not tapering or ending in the middle. Do not duplicate or add any new stone joints, grids, lattice, cracks, white scratches or scored lines. The quiet pavement may retain very broad very low-contrast painterly facets but no obvious checker pattern or band. No symbols, new objects, additional lanterns or base. Preserve framing.
